text:
Great question! When you delete your account, your subscriptions are automatically cancelled as part of that process.

Here's what happens: account deletion takes up to **30 days** to complete, and your Plant Club subscription will be cancelled during that time. You can manage the deletion yourself under **Account > Privacy** on the website or app.

One thing to note: if your Plant Club has already been charged for the next month (charges happen on the 25th of the previous month), that box will still be sent to you even after cancellation—it won't be refunded. But no further charges will occur after deletion is initiated.

Would you like any other details?
